title: Whose Journey Matters? Investigating Identity Biases in Large Language Models (LLMs) for Travel Planning Assistance

bias_targets.methodology: Fairness probing of LLM-generated travel recommendations by training logistic regression classifiers on TF-IDF word vectors to detect distinct word distributions, extracting influential text features via a One-vs-Rest strategy, and analyzing the occurrence of hallucinations across four ethnic groups (African American, Asian, Caucasian, Hispanic).

Fairness probing of LLM-generated travel recommendations by training logistic regression classifiers on TF-IDF word vectors to detect distinct word distributions, extracting influential text features via a One-vs-Rest strategy, and analyzing the occurrence of hallucinations across three gender identities (man, woman, gender minority).
